excluded_diagnostic.reason: The predeclared byte-for-byte equality with the older J05 report failed: explicit -rpts adds report.database_version and leaves SystemResults/StockTotalResults instance_name empty, while all common columns and 72 data rows matched.

settings.delta: Only eight single-byte MissionSettings selection values change from N to Y in a copy of the installed Default.sxs; all other bytes are identical. The derived proprietary settings file stays under ignored runs/.

manual.rule: Report settings can be saved and loaded as .sxs; -rpts loads a specified settings file and -report generates a report from an existing .sxo. Report table selection is per configured identifier combination.

scope: One previously accepted J05/A01 SXO, three fresh report-only exports in order: explicit default-a, mission-enabled, explicit default-b. No simulation recalculation or source model change. Compare tabular columns and rows to the older parent after separately recording export metadata and instance labels.
acceptance_hypotheses: The source SXO, parent closure, settings and executable remain SHA-stable through all three guarded session-0 SSH report steps while the protected GUI survives.

The two fresh default report JSON exports are byte-identical to each other. Their four table names, columns and row data equal the accepted J05 baseline report; any report-level metadata or instance_name difference from that older export is disclosed explicitly.

The mission-enabled export adds exactly MissionResults, MissionResultsTotal, FixedMissionResults and FixedMissionResultsTotal, with 72 half-hour MissionResults bins and a one-row fixed mission summary. Common ProblemDescription, ResultSummary, SystemResults and StockTotalResults table columns and data rows equal the fresh default exports.

The single mission starts at hour 8, succeeds at 10, and has two completed operating hours in the mission-enabled report; its 72 System and Stock bins and terminal state remain those of the accepted parent.
A separate reviewer independently verifies source fingerprints, all raw seals, settings byte delta, report table equality, event/report reconciliation and no model recalculation.
gate: Publish only if all three fresh report outputs and independent replay satisfy these frozen row-data and selection hypotheses. Keep older-export metadata/instance-label differences visible, and do not claim byte equality with the parent. If any report-selection or row-data hypothesis fails, retain this version as an excluded diagnostic and freeze a new version.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, GUI PID13340/session1 identity, immutable run path, hidden native children, targeted watchdog, source hashes before/after and raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: One previously simulated fixed-seed SXO and two settings. No GUI visual comparison, export to images/spreadsheets, report formatting fidelity, alternate model, cross-engine or full K09 claim.
